arms.description: Question plus shuffled candidate cards containing paths and bounded symbol summaries.

The same candidate cards plus a structured observation projected from the canonical CodebaseSceneCompiler graph.holo scene: spatial coordinates, visual style, community, import degree, and visible candidate edges.

design.candidateConstruction: Include every source-audited relevant file, then fill the remaining slots with label-blind HoloEmbed GraphRAG hard negatives from src/ that resolve to canonical CodebaseSceneCompiler nodes. Relevance labels are used only to guarantee answer presence and are never serialized into an agent prompt.
design.candidateScopeBoundary: Because every relevant file is inserted into the candidate set, this protocol measures agent selection and ranking from a bounded view. It does not measure end-to-end retrieval recall.
design.counterbalancing: Two deterministic SHA-256 orders are reversed across arms and swapped for half of the queries. Each request is stateless.
design.promptInjectionBoundary: Raw source bodies and doc comments are excluded. Candidate evidence is limited to normalized paths, symbol names, symbol types, bounded signatures, and generated graph metadata.

responseSchema.rankedCandidateIds: array of one to five candidate IDs in descending relevance order

preregisteredSuccess.interpretation: Both paired accuracy confidence intervals must exclude zero in the positive direction, and structured graph context may not increase invalid responses by more than two percentage points.

claimBoundary.reason: A single owned 4B model run is model-specific pilot evidence. Publication claims require at least three independently operated agent families, three trials per arm, independent multi-human relevance annotation, and external-codebase replication.
claimBoundary.measuredSurface: agent-readable structured projection of the canonical visual graph
claimBoundary.nextGate: Add a screenshot or interactive viewport arm for a vision-capable agent after the structured visual-graph pilot is frozen.
